summary: The actual REJECT is a defensible conservative response to the supplied current-revision identity condition, but its decisive uncertainty is introduced by the isolated Goal clone. It does not demonstrate A3/A7 repair or complete11-case evaluation. G2/A1/A3/A7 required observations remain unread or insufficient, despite the reason broadly claiming actual per-case originals were checked. No false-approval occurs in this run; a negative verdict is not automatically a semantic-improvement PASS.
